t2.thesis: WDC will likely beat the $4.08 consensus, but a 1-for-4 record of beats being sold, a sector-wide HDD/memory de-rating and competition and AI-funding worries make the gap direction close to a coin flip with a slight upward tilt from washed-out positioning.
reasons: Consensus EPS of $4.08 sits only slightly above the $4.00 guidance midpoint, and WDC has beaten by 8-14% in each of the last 4 prints (I2, I4).
Despite those beats, only 1 of the last 4 open-to-open reactions was positive, including -21% last quarter (I2).
The stock is down 49% from its 52-week high and 18% over the past month, and the week before the snapshot was a 16% plunge. That washes out expectations and leaves room for a relief rally (I2, I26).
Options positioning tilts mildly bullish: call IV is above put IV, put/call volume is 0.41, and put/call open interest is 0.67 (I2).
The overhang is sector-wide fear about competition, AI funding and Chinese memory supply, and Morgan Stanley cut its target even while staying bullish (I19, I20, I22).
t2.deciding_variable: The Q2FY27 revenue and gross-margin guide versus a buy-side whisper above consensus, plus any commentary on hyperscaler HDD demand durability and pricing.

theses.mechanism: A clean beat and a guide above the street, landing on a stock already de-rated 49%, trigger short covering and a relief gap.
theses.wrong_if: The guide is only in line, or gross margin flattens near 55-56%.

theses.mechanism: As in the last three prints, a beat that was already expected meets peak-cycle fears, and holders sell into strength.
theses.wrong_if: Management raises long-term agreement visibility or pricing commentary materially.

theses.wrong_if: The macro or tech tape sells off on Oct 22, or Meta's capex commentary disappoints AI-funding hopes.
